description: The bar chart illustrates the Accuracy (%) of six different classification methods. The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and uses a linear scale with a visible range from 40% to 65%, featuring numeric tick labels at regular 5% intervals and corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines. The horizontal category axis lacks a formal title and displays six individual, unstacked bars whose identities are defined by a legend on the right. From left to right, the chart presents a light grey bar for "RoBERTa w/o Exp." at approximately 46.5%, which is the shortest bar; a light blue bar for "ExEnt" at roughly 55%; an orange bar for "LaSQuE (mean)" at about 47%; a green bar for "LaSQuE" also near 47%; a purple bar at approximately 58.5%, which corresponds to a legend entry with a blank grey rectangle instead of text; and a dark grey bar for "LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)", which is the tallest bar at approximately 62%. The bars are not sorted by height, and each is visually emphasized with a thin black outline.
